deviations.what: PR3 and PR4 merge as ONE pull request instead of two, so the batch ships three PRs rather than the four c24 confirmed
deviations.reason: Operator instruction, and it satisfies the reasons behind the constraint rather than breaking them. c31 required sequential merges because four concurrently-open PRs collide on pyproject.toml and CHANGELOG.md and the version-check job blocks whichever loses the race -- one PR cannot collide with itself. c30 required PR1 first because it changed scripts/merge-gate.py, the program gating the rest; PR1 (#158) and PR2 (#159) are both merged, so that ordering is already honoured. What changes is only c24's four-PR split.
